correctness.rationale: The finite metric space and inclusive scale are explicit. The Rips complex is exactly the independence complex of the graph joining pairs at distance greater than four. Complete independent-set enumeration gives the face vector; exact sparse boundary reduction over \(\mathbb F_2\) gives the listed ranks. The formula \(\beta_d=f_d-r_d-r_{d+1}\) yields \(\beta_5=23\), \(\beta_8=2\), \(\beta_0=1\), and zero in every other degree. Two executions with distinct vertex indexings agree on every face count and rank. The claim does not extrapolate to integral homology or homotopy.
